_comment: Student registry. The KEY is the card UID exactly as the ESP32 prints it:
uppercase hex, no spaces, no colons.
The four UIDs below are your real cards, read from your own serial log.
Replace the names, studentIds and classes with the real students.
parentChatId is currently YOUR Telegram id on every card, so every tap messages
you while testing. Swap in each parent's own id before going live.
New card? Tap it, read the UID from attendance/unknown_uids.csv, add it here,
then click the 'Load student DB' inject in Node-RED. No restart needed.
